title: Bahama Breeze House | KEY.co
description_expanded: The moment you cross the threshold, a bright and welcoming interior unfolds, designed to make every moment of your stay memorable. Relax on plush furniture in the living area, perfect for engaging conversations or movie nights on the large TV. Culinary enthusiasts will delight in the full kitchen, boasting modern stainless steel appliances and a floating island breakfast bar for morning gatherings. The main bedroom, a haven of tranquility, offers direct balcony access and an en suite bathroom with luxurious features, including a double-sink vanity and a soaking tub. Meanwhile, kids will cherish moments spent in the cozy bunk beds. Outside, a sparkling pool awaits for leisurely days under the sun, and the private patio and balcony offer front-row seats to the breathtaking Florida coast sunsets, promising an unforgettable backdrop to your beach getaway. Step into a slice of paradise at Miramar Beach, where every day is an invitation to embrace the coastal lifestyle to the fullest. Located just a block away from the pristine white sands, this home is your gateway to the best of the Florida panhandle. Indulge in exhilarating water sports like parasailing, surfing, and deep-sea fishing in the Gulf of Mexico, or explore the vibrant local culture through its cuisine, arts, and entertainment. With a golf cart and four bikes at your disposal, navigating the area and discovering its myriad family-friendly attractions becomes an effortless adventure.
